method: score = rc + evict + deposit + cause + notice (each 0-2; 10 = most landlord-friendly). Editorial index for investment screening, not legal advice. Re-verify annually.

AL.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 7-business-day pay-or-quit keeps notice at 1 (iPropertyManagement eviction-process table).

AK.note: No RC preemption statute but none enacted (NAA/Commoner Law); deposit capped 2 months when rent<=$2,000; fast FED process.

AZ.note: Preempts RC; 1.5-month deposit cap scores 0; 5-day pay-or-quit, no late-fee cap.

AR.note: Preempts RC; 2-month deposit cap (owners of >5 units); 6-8 wk eviction (iPM).

CA.note: AB 1482 statewide 5%+CPI cap + just cause; AB 12 (7/2024) 1-month deposit cap; 3-day pay-or-quit and no statutory late-fee cap keep notice at 2; 5-8 wk typical eviction.

CO.note: Still preempts local RC (repeal failed), but HB24-1098 statewide for-cause eviction (PolicyLink); 2-month deposit cap (2023); 10-day cure + $50/5% late-fee cap + 7-day grace = heavy notice burden.

CT.note: No RC ban; mandatory fair-rent commissions in towns >25k can roll back rents (scored 1); 2-month deposit cap (1 month for 62+); 9-day late-fee grace.

DE.note: No preemption, none enacted; 1-month deposit cap on year+ leases; 5% late-fee cap + 5-day grace.

FL.note: 2023 preemption law (SB 102) killed local RC referenda; no deposit cap; 3-day pay-or-quit; 2-10 wk eviction, uncontested nonpayment typically <6 wk.

GA.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; generous late-fee allowance ($20 or 20%); Atlanta court backlog puts eviction at 1-3 months (iPM).

HI.note: No preemption, none enacted; 1-month deposit cap (+1-month pet); 8% late-fee cap + 5-day grace; 1-4 month eviction.

ID.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 3-day notice; expedited nonpayment eviction (1 wk-2 mo).

IL.note: Rent Control Preemption Act 1997 still in force per LawDistrict/NAA 2026 (one source claimed 2024 repeal - not corroborated); no statewide deposit cap (Chicago/Cook ordinances apply locally); Cook County eviction slow (2 wk-5 mo).

IN.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 10-day pay-or-quit keeps notice at 1.

IA.note: Preempts RC; 2-month deposit cap; statutory per-day late-fee caps ($60-$100/mo max) score 1; 3-day notice, fast courts.

KS.note: Preempts RC; 1-month deposit cap (1.5 furnished) scores 0; 3-day notice.

KY.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 3-6 wk eviction; 7-day pay-or-quit + 10% late-fee cap in URLTA cities = 1.

LA.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 5-day notice; 2-5 wk eviction, among fastest.

ME.note: Portland + South Portland active rent control (LawDistrict); 2-month deposit cap; 4% late-fee cap + mandatory 15-day grace = heaviest notice burden in US (Hemlane).

MD.note: Active county rent stabilization: Takoma Park, Montgomery Co (2024), Prince George's Co; deposit cap cut to 1 month eff. 10/2024; 5% late-fee cap + 10-day notice before nonpayment filing.

MA.note: RC banned by 1994 ballot initiative; 1-month deposit cap with strict treble-damage penalties; 14-day cure + no late fee until 30 days late = 0 notice.

MI.note: Preempts RC; 1.5-month deposit cap; 7-day notice; 2 wk-2 mo eviction.

MN.note: St. Paul 3% rent stabilization active for pre-2005 buildings (post-2004 construction permanently exempted by 5/2025 council vote, eff. 6/13/2025; Minn. Stat. 471.9996 allows RC by referendum) so rc=0; no deposit cap; 14-day nonpayment notice (2023) + 8% late-fee cap = 0 notice.

MS.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 3-day notice; 2-8 wk eviction.

MO.note: Preempts RC; 2-month deposit cap; no notice statutorily required before nonpayment filing; 1-3 mo eviction (St. Louis/KC dockets).

MT.note: RC preemption enacted 2023 (NAA); no deposit cap; 3-day nonpayment notice; 10% late-fee cap is permissive.

NE.note: Preempts RC (LawDistrict); 1-month deposit cap; 7-day notice; expedited eviction.

NV.note: No local RC and treated as preempted/Dillon (Commoner Law lists NV as preempt; LawDistrict as Dillon-barred) - either way no local RC possible, rc=2; 3-month deposit cap; summary eviction 1-6 wks; 5% late-fee cap + 3-day grace.

NH.note: No local RC authority; BUT RSA 540 requires good cause for eviction since 2015 (PolicyLink/Wikipedia) so cause=0; deposit capped at greater of 1 month/$100.

NJ.note: 100+ municipal rent control ordinances; Anti-Eviction Act 1974 statewide just cause (PolicyLink); 1.5-month deposit cap; 3 wk-4 mo eviction with lockout backlogs; no pay-or-quit required for nonpayment filing keeps notice at 2.

NM.note: Statutory RC prohibition (NMSA 47-8-15.2); deposit capped 1 month only for leases <1 yr (no cap on annual leases) = 1; 3-day notice, 2-7 wk eviction.

NY.note: HSTPA 2019 + Good Cause Eviction Law 2024 (immediate in NYC, opt-in upstate - PolicyLink); 1-month deposit cap; $50/5% late-fee cap + 5-day grace + 14-day notice; 1-5 mo eviction, NYC routinely >12 wks.

NC.note: Preempts RC; deposit cap 1.5 mo (m2m)/2 mo (longer) = 1; $15-or-5% late-fee cap + 5-day grace + 10-day pay-or-quit = 0 notice.

ND.note: Preempts RC; 1-month deposit cap; 3-day notice; 2-8 wk eviction.

OH.note: RC preemption enacted 2022 (HB 430, eff. 9/22/2022); no deposit cap; 3-day notice; 5-8 wk eviction.

OK.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 5-day notice; 2-7 wk eviction.

OR.note: SB 608 (2019) statewide rent cap (7%+CPI, amended 2023 to max 10%; 2026 cap 9.5%) + just cause; no statutory deposit cap = 2; 72/144-hr notice but 4-8 day grace + 5% late-fee cap = 1.

PA.note: No preemption, no local RC; Philadelphia good-cause ordinance = partial (cause 1); 2-month deposit cap in year 1; 10-day notice.

RI.note: No preemption, none enacted; 1-month deposit cap; 15-day grace before nonpayment notice; 1-4 mo eviction.

SC.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 5-day notice; 4-9 wk eviction.

SD.note: Preempts RC; 1-month deposit cap; 3-day notice; 5 wk-3 mo eviction.

TN.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 14-day nonpayment cure in URLTA counties + 10% late-fee cap + 5-day grace = 1; 4-8 wk eviction.

TX.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 3-day notice, 2-day grace, 12% late-fee cap is permissive; uncontested nonpayment ~3-5 wks.

UT.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 3-day notice and expedited possession orders - among the fastest evictions.

VT.note: No preemption (Burlington just-cause charter vetoed); no deposit cap; but 4-7 month evictions (iPM, slowest in US) and 14-day cure = 0s.

VA.note: Dillon rule bars local RC (LawDistrict); 2-month deposit cap; 5-day pay-or-quit + 10% late-fee cap still light; 2-4 mo total but uncontested ~6-8 wks.

WA.note: HB 1217 (2025) statewide rent stabilization, lesser of 7%+CPI or 10% (NAA Fall 2025 Outlook); just cause since 2021; no statewide deposit cap (Seattle caps locally) = 2; 14-day notice + 5-day grace + late-fee limits = 0.

WV.note: Preempts RC (Commoner Law); no deposit cap; NO notice required before nonpayment filing; fast wrongful-occupation process.

WI.note: Preempts RC; no deposit cap; 5-day notice but 5% late-fee cap = 1; 2-4 mo eviction.

WY.note: No RC anywhere (preemption status disputed between sources; scored 1 conservatively); no deposit cap; 3-day notice; 3-4 wk eviction, fastest tier.

DC.note: Rental Housing Act rent stabilization (pre-1976 buildings); eviction only for cause; 1-month deposit cap; 30-day nonpayment notice; 2-8 month evictions.
